period_note: SOLO/SEPARATE basis ('Condensed Balance Sheet'/'Condensed Profit & Loss Account' headed 'Eastern Bank PLC.', distinct from the 'and its subsidiaries' Consolidated columns). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (column header '01 January 2024 to 31 March 2024'), flagged via the _cumulative suffix. RESTATEMENT/DISCREPANCY FOUND (comparative column vs existing file, not edited): this filing's 31-Dec-2023 Solo comparative column shows total_equity = BDT 39,767m and total_assets = BDT 508,554m, whereas bank_financials/EBL/quarterly/2023_Q4.json (sourced from the FY2025 annual report's 'Five-year Progression' table) shows total_equity = BDT 37,484m and total_assets = BDT 506,271m — both differ by exactly the same BDT 2,283m. Total liabilities match exactly between the two sources (468,787m both ways per this filing's own calculation and 2023_Q4.json's calculated_from_assets_minus_equity basis), which isolates the entire assets/equity gap to the equity side, not a loans, deposits, or borrowings reclassification (those all cross-check exactly: gross_loans 353,357m, total_deposits 366,104m, borrowings 71,668m, paid_up_capital 12,072m — all match 2023_Q4.json precisely). Separately, this filing's Dec-2023 comparative 'Fixed assets including land, building, furniture and fixtures' = BDT 8,517m, vs 2023_Q4.json's fixed_assets = BDT 5,994m (+42%, BDT 2,523m) — a large, presentation-specific gap plausibly explained by a later separation of right-of-use lease assets out of the 'Fixed assets' line (the 2026-vintage filings' notes show a distinct 'Right of use assets' sub-line of a similar order of magnitude), though this was not fully traced to a specific reclassifying disclosure. Per project rule, this file reports only its own filing's own figures for 31 March 2024 (the reporting date); no historical file was edited to reconcile either discrepancy — both are recorded here and in sources.json for visibility. Both current-period fixed_assets (8,457m) and total_equity (39,757m) below reflect this filing's own presentation and are internally consistent with its own balance sheet identity.
